name: tday.com
long_description: Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.
one_liner: AI-recorded Screen Studio style editable demos
